title: Chapter 305
text:
In the tower of Sanctuary Three, Bennett stood in front of the window with his hands behind his back. He looked down at the players walking around the square with a deep gaze.

The door was pushed open, and Han Xiao walked in. Bennett turned around with a serious expression. "Is that alien still alive?"

Han Xiao moved aside, and Kerlodd also walked in. Bennett narrowed his eyes. It was his first time seeing an alien, so he could not help but take a few more looks at it.

"Native, what are you looking at?" Kerlodd said unhappily.

"He's speaking our language?" Bennett was surprised.

Helpless, Han Xiao pointed at the translator and explained. Only then did Bennett feel relieved.

"The alien's technology is indeed high-end." Bennett sighed. He looked at the two of them and asked, "Didn't you catch him? Why does it look like …"

"We've reached a consensus." Han Xiao did not want Kerlodd to hear the rest of the conversation, so he took off the translator.

"How do you know about the alien?" Han Xiao asked.

Bennett shook his head and said, "Raylan told me. Otherwise, I wouldn't have known about the alien's arrival. They found you and confirmed that you caught the alien, so they contacted me secretly and asked you to hand the alien to them."

Raylan? Han Xiao was not surprised. According to the clues, they could indeed find him. He did not plan to hide it because there was no need to.

"What if I refuse?"

"Their official statement is that they will not rule out violence. Raylan's attitude this time is very firm."

Han Xiao was not only the person who destroyed the Germinal Organization, but also the strongest Super in Blue Star. The Six Nations respected him a lot, but this time, Raylan was very firm and did not plan to give him face. They wanted to force Han Xiao to hand over Godora and have him in their hands. Han Xiao shook his head. Raylan's hostility was meaningless to him.

Bennett was very annoyed. "Can you tell me why you can kidnap an alien just by going out for a walk? What are you trying to do?"

Han Xiao sat down and stared at Bennett. "I'm preparing to leave Blue Star."

Bennett was stunned.

Are you trying to ascend to heaven?!

This news was too sudden. After a while, Bennett came back to his senses and asked in surprise, "Why? You can't really be an alien, right? "

"Compared to the starry sky, the Blue Star is just a small, remote place. The world is so big, I want to see it." Han Xiao smiled.

So this is the reason for capturing aliens …

Bennett quickly adjusted his state of mind. After all, he had been through a lot. He said with some regret, "You are a like-minded partner. If you have really decided, I can only wish you success. I will miss you."

Han Xiao stared into his eyes and said with a smile, "That is a much bigger world. Are you not moved? Do you want to go with me?"

Bennett was slightly dazed. It was as if he saw the boundless starry sky in Han Xiao's eyes. A man's romance was the sea of stars. The higher one stood, the further one could see.

His heart throbbed, and his instinctive desire to explore rose continuously.

However, Bennett quickly calmed down and shook his head. "The Sanctuary is my philosophy. Sorry, I still have to continue this career."

Han Xiao hesitated for a moment before saying, "Actually, there is another reason. A catastrophe will sweep through Blue Star in two to three years. I have foreseen this scene. It is a terrifying catastrophe, and there is only a slim chance of survival … Are you really not going to leave?"

He decided to remind Bennett of the arrival of the Mutation Disaster. No matter what, Bennett had treated him well, and it was very dangerous to stay in Blue Star. One of the main reasons why Han Xiao wanted to head to the galaxy in Version 1.0 was to avoid the first wave of the Mutation Disaster that would descend on Blue Star.

Han Xiao's identity as a suspected foreseer made his' prophecies' believable.

However, after Bennett listened to Han Xiao's description of the disaster seriously, his hesitation disappeared, and he said with a serious expression, "Then I have to stay even more. This is my hometown, and she needs me."

Han Xiao stared at Bennett for a long time before letting out a long sigh.

"… That's true. You are indeed such a person."

Everyone had their own ambitions, and they could not be forced. Bennett stared at Han Xiao with a complicated expression and asked, "Are you thinking of leaving to avoid danger?"

Han Xiao smiled and said, "The solution to the disaster is hidden in the galaxy. I am not only trying to avoid danger but also to find a solution in the galaxy."

He was indeed not lying to Bennett. Finding a way to solve the Mutation Disaster in Version 2.0 was also part of his plan. If he could change the storyline of Blue Star Version 2.0, he would definitely be able to increase his Legendary Points.

Hearing that, Bennett smiled and said, "I was not wrong about you. When I heard your speech in the past, I knew that we were the same kind of people."

Of course not! Han Xiao's mouth twitched. That speech was copied from Bennett's original words. The last time Han Xiao went to Sanctuary One to find him, he saw that speech hanging in Bennett's office. He even specifically stated that the original author was Han Xiao, continuously expressing his respect for that sentence. This made Han Technician feel a little awkward.

However, although the starting point was different, the goal was the same, so there was no need to talk about motives.

Since he knew what Han Xiao was thinking, Bennett threw the ultimatum of Raylan out of the window.

"How are you going to leave Blue Star?"

"I have already arranged it. You will know when the time comes."

Seeing that Han Xiao did not want to reveal the details, Bennett could only suppress his curiosity and said, "If you leave, Sanctuary Three will need to choose a new person to be in charge. Do you have a recommendation?"

Han Xiao thought for a while and said, "Huang Yu. He is the one who handles the daily affairs of the sanctuary. He is very familiar with the situation here, so he is the most suitable person to take over."

After the influence of the Pro League, the impression of Sanctuary Three as a main city had been formed. Even if he left, it would not affect the status of the sanctuary. Sanctuary Three had his name on it, and every player who came would have a deeper impression of him.

However, the players in the sanctuary would not be able to enjoy his various' functions', and this might cause the sanctuary to lose some of its popularity.

Han Xiao suddenly had a new idea. "Maybe there is a way. Even if I leave the planet, I can continue to strengthen the influence of the sanctuary …"

Since he had already revealed the Mutation Disaster to Bennett, this' prophecy 'should have more uses. Han Xiao thought about it for a while and came up with a concrete plan, which he kept in mind.

On the other hand, Bennett felt that Huang Yu was a good choice. Suddenly, he said with a serious tone, "There are too many Inhumans in Sanctuary Three, even more than the refugees in the sanctuary. They take up too much space. Their origins are unknown, and they are too mysterious. This is a security risk. I don't know how you can make them work for you, but if you leave, what will they do?

"When the disaster comes, the Inhumans will very likely be the backbone of the sanctuary. Don't be too harsh on them. You have to accept them and accept them." As the players grew, the various organizations in Blue Star became more and more wary of the 'Inhumans'. Bennett was not an exception. Only by convincing Bennett could he ensure that his achievements in Blue Star would not be ruined.

Hearing this, Bennett's expression changed. "If that's really the case, I will take it seriously." Although he was wary of the Inhumans, knowing that the Inhumans could protect the sanctuary, he immediately changed his attitude. This reason was very useful to him.

The two of them chatted for a while more before Bennett stood up and said goodbye. He came this time to deal with Raylan's warning, but he accidentally found out about Han Xiao's next move. As such, Raylan's warning was no longer a concern, and he did not need to worry.

Instead, it was the catastrophe that Han Xiao revealed that made his heart feel heavy. He felt as if there was a dark cloud hanging over the road ahead. He decided to immediately go back and write a crisis plan to increase the sanctuary's defense and speed up the progress of the plan.

Bennett could not bear to part with a partner like Han Xiao, so he sincerely said, "I hope everything goes well for you. We will meet again soon."

Han Xiao reached out his hand and shook Bennett's.

The two of them looked at each other and smiled.

…

Bennett's arrival reminded Han Xiao that he should inform some of his friends. Hella and Aurora were staying in the sanctuary because of him, so Han Xiao decided to inform them first.

That night, the moon was bright and the clouds were clear. He gathered Hella and Aurora and revealed that he was going to travel to the galaxy.

As expected, the two of them were extremely shocked, and their faces were filled with disbelief.

"Han Xiao, what is the universe like? Have you ever met an alien? "Aurora hurriedly asked.

In the past few days, Aurora had been resting in the sanctuary and had already recovered. Han Xiao finally corrected the way she called him and was no longer called an old-fashioned uncle.

Han Xiao asked Kerlodd to come closer and said, "This is an alien."

Aurora's bright eyes were filled with curiosity. "An alien looks like us. Will it bite?"

This question again! Can you natives be more knowledgeable?!

Kerlodd's face darkened. He could not take it anymore and roared, "You are the one who will bite!"

Bang!

Kerlodd fell flat on his face.

Han Xiao put down his hand and said with an unfriendly face, "Be more polite to children."

Aurora shrunk back and mumbled, "Aliens are so scary."
